content: Texts, questions and answers were tokenized using NLTK and lowercased. We used 100-dimensional GloVe vectors BIBREF16 to embed each token. For the neural models, the embeddings are used to initialize the token representations, and are refined during training. For the sliding similarity window approach, we set INLINEFORM0 .
